command: STATE=$(adb shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9]\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); if [ "$STATE" = "2" ]; then mkdir -p /tmp/aicallbridge-live; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py capture 3000 /tmp/aicallbridge-live/now.wav; ls -l /tmp/aicallbridge-live/now.wav; swift scripts/transcribe_audio.swift /tmp/aicallbridge-live/now.wav || true; else echo NO_ACTIVE_CALL_CAPTURE_SKIPPED; fi
